title: 第7章 老夫竟是掌门的炉鼎突破第8章 身中八刀自杀身亡
content_zh:
林陌傻眼了，你特么管这叫小小的改动？！
还能再坑一点吗？
早知道这么坑的话，林陌都不这么着急修炼这阴阳邪魔功了。
“嘿嘿，所以，后世修炼此功法者，修炼此功法之后，可要精心挑选双修之人，莫怪本座没有提醒。”
“若是身怀亿万中无一的纯阳圣体，则把本座上面的话当放屁即可。”
“还好还好，吓老子一跳！”
听完最后一段话，林陌那颗悬着的心，总算放下来了。
早说纯阳圣体不受影响不就行了嘛，害得老夫还担心了好一会儿！
“老夫终于明白，柳紫嫣这女魔头为什么不杀我了。”
既然阳卷会绑定第一次双修之人的阴气，那阴卷大概也一样。
柳紫嫣想继续修炼阴阳邪魔功，并且迈向更高的境界的话，那她就不能杀自己。
难怪当时完事之后，柳紫嫣不仅给他阴阳邪魔功阳卷的修炼之法，还给续命丹和修炼资源！
敢情她是想把自己当成长期的炉鼎啊！
“对象是柳紫嫣的话，老夫倒也可以勉强接受...”
别的不说，柳紫嫣的身材和颜值确实够顶。
自己还激活了纯阳圣体，完全不用担心被柳紫嫣榨干。
待林陌修炼起来之后，谁把谁当炉鼎，那可就不好说了！
“但在这之前，老夫还是得苟活一阵...”
虽说柳紫嫣是绑定了他的阳气，可这并不代表，他就可以在柳紫嫣面前肆无忌惮地骑脸输出了。
若是惹恼了柳紫嫣，她哪怕是拼着转修其他功法的高成本，也会将自己当场镇杀吧？

不过至少，自己应该是不用像以前那样那么低声下气，在夹缝中求生了。
只要不触及柳紫嫣的底线，和向她提出太过分的要求，想来柳紫嫣应该是会睁一只眼闭一只眼的。
“嗯...眼下还是先提升修为吧。”
但在正式修炼之前，还是得先吞服一枚续命丹才行。
林陌估算着，他的寿元顶多还有不到半个月时间。
纵使是有纯阳圣体以及阴阳邪魔功加持，他显然也是无法在短短的半个月不到的时间里。
从炼气二重突破到筑基期的。
只有突破到筑基期，他这具肉体凡胎的躯体，才能突破寿命的上限。
从柳紫嫣给予的储物戒里，找到龙眼大小的续命丹。
林陌毫不犹豫地将其吞服了下去。
续命丹味道较为苦涩，但入口即化。
药效顺着喉咙进入体内，仅片刻功夫，林陌便是可以清楚地感觉到，一股生机盎然的能量，在体内遍布开来。
不多时，他那双浑浊的眼睛，变得清澈了不少。
满是岁月痕迹，如同枯萎的花一般的皮肤，竟像是逆转了时间的创伤。
content_en:
Lin Mo was dumbfounded, why do you call this a small change? !
Can it be tricked a little more?
If he had known it was such a scam, Lin Mo wouldn't be so anxious to practice the Yin Yang Demonic Skill.
"Hehe, so those who practice this technique in future generations must carefully select people who practice dual cultivation after practicing this technique. No wonder I didn't remind you."
"If you possess a Pure Yang Holy Body that is unique among billions, just treat the words above me as farts."
"It's okay, it's okay, I was shocked!"
After listening to the last paragraph, Lin Mo's anxious heart finally relaxed.
Couldn't I have just said that the Pure Yang Holy Body would not be affected? It made me worry for a while!
"I finally understand why Liu Ziyan, the female devil, doesn't kill me."
Since the yang scroll will bind the yin energy of the person who practices dual cultivation for the first time, the yin scroll will probably do the same.
If Liu Ziyan wants to continue practicing Yin Yang Demonic Skills and move to a higher realm, then she cannot kill herself.
No wonder after that, Liu Ziyan not only gave him the cultivation method of Yin Yang Demon Gong Yang Scroll, but also gave him life-sustaining pills and cultivation resources!
I bet she wants to use herself as a long-term furnace!
"If the target is Liu Ziyan, I can reluctantly accept it..."
Apart from anything else, Liu Ziyan's figure and appearance are indeed top-notch.
He also activated the Pure Yang Holy Body, so he didn't have to worry about being drained by Liu Ziyan.
After Lin Mo starts practicing, it's hard to say who will be used as the cauldron!
"But before that, I still have to survive for a while..."
Although Liu Ziyan has bound his Yang Qi, this does not mean that he can act unscrupulously in front of Liu Ziyan.
If Liu Ziyan was offended, she would kill her on the spot, even if she went to the high cost of switching to other techniques, right?
But at least, I shouldn't have to be as humble as before and survive in the cracks.
As long as she doesn't touch Liu Ziyan's bottom line or make excessive demands on her, Liu Ziyan will probably turn a blind eye.
"Well... let's improve our cultivation level now."
But before formal practice, you still have to swallow a life-sustaining pill.
Lin Mo estimated that he would have less than half a month to live at most.
Even with the blessings of the Pure Yang Holy Body and the Yin Yang Demonic Art, he obviously couldn't do it in less than half a month.
From the second level of Qi refining to the foundation building stage.
Only by breaking through to the foundation building stage can his mortal body break through the upper limit of lifespan.
From the storage ring given by Liu Ziyan, I found a life-sustaining pill the size of a dragon's eye.
Lin Mo swallowed it without hesitation.
The life-sustaining pill has a bitter taste, but it melts in your mouth.
The effect of the medicine entered the body along the throat, and in just a moment, Lin Mo could clearly feel a vibrant energy spreading throughout the body.
After a while, his cloudy eyes became much clearer.
The skin is full of traces of time, like a withered flower, and seems to have reversed the trauma of time.
